messages:
laura: quick sync - i reviewed the retention examples in the audit-exports doc and noticed JS/Py samples use different field names and one shows full prompt text. we should harmonize and avoid showing raw prompt content.

mike: which field names do we have? i saw `expires_at` (ISO) in JS, `ttl` (seconds) in py, and `retentionDays` in the ruby example.

samir: proposed standard: `retention_period_days` (int). clear and language-agnostic. also add a note: values are subject to legal holds and manual export approvals.

naomi: security ask: phrase retention as "retained for N days" not "permanently stored". and replace raw prompt snippet with pseudonymized tokenization example.

laura: ok. can we also update the field table on the audit-exports page so snippets and API reference match? that'll reduce confusion.

mike: i'll make a PR that: 1) replaces all SDK examples to use `retention_period_days`, 2) swaps raw prompt with a pseudonymized example `prompt_id: "p_..."` and shows how to map it back via the admin console, 3) adds a small callout about export approvals.

security-bot: note from security review: examples implying instant tenant-wide export must be removed or clearly labeled "requires admin approval".

samir: i'll also add a tiny docs test to validate sample fields against the canonical audit schema so future PRs don't drift.

devex-bot: PR created: #3225 by mike - "docs: harmonize retention examples + pseudonymize prompt sample" - https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3225

laura: thanks. mike, tag compliance and security in the PR description and add links to the internal retention guide for wording.

mike: will do. pinging compliance for final wording pass.

naomi: once PR is green, please squash-merge and include CHANGELOG line: "docs(security): align retention snippet field names; remove raw prompt example; clarify export approval"

laura: perfect. small change but important for SOC2-friendly docs.
